decisions.reason: A fifteen-day express program is a low-cost service built on existing production and supports competitiveness with trade partners, so it is likely kept or folded into the general express offer.
Seventy-two-hour delivery strongly differentiates the firm for urgent replacement needs, though stocking it is somewhat demanding, so it will probably be kept.
The European-certified fire-resistant exterior door extends the modular Teckentrup 62 system and was launched at the BAU trade fair, making it a core product with long-term value.
The umbrella express program for doors and gates has its own page and fits the firm's fast-response promise, so it will likely remain, possibly consolidated with A and B.
The online ordering and digital services platform supports trade partners and the firm's digitalisation and service strategy, so dropping it is unlikely.
Fire and smoke protection doors are a certified, regulation-driven core segment with steady demand in building projects.
